headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 24, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a standout performance from Dansby Swanson, who hit a grand slam and recorded 2 home runs, 7 RBIs, and 2 hits in the game. The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-3 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Shawn Armstrong earning the win.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Ryan McMahon, third baseman for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a throat infection, effective retroactive to June 22, 2026. The Chicago Cubs have placed RHP Ben Brown on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 21, 2026, due to a neck strain, and RHP Edward Cabrera on the 15-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The Colorado Rockies have placed RHP Jaden Hill on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 21, 2026, due to right shoulder tendonitis, and RHP Blas Castaño on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, due to a right pectoral strain.

Several trades and roster movements have occurred. The St. Louis Cardinals made a trade on June 23, 2026, sending RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash, and RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.
